title: U.S. state or local government website under ADA Title II
claim_boundary: Diligent 0.1.0 can only record the facts and obligations for a state or local entity under this research profile and compute a deterministic gate from supplied results; local privacy, language, records, and security overlays are not researched, no automated check ships, and nothing it produces is a certification or a statement of ADA compliance.
notes: Research profile, not a published profile. Current Department of Justice guidance gives April 26, 2027 for entities with a population of 50,000 or more and April 26, 2028 for smaller entities and special district governments. Existing ADA duties continue before those dates. WCAG 2.1 AA includes every WCAG 2.0 A/AA criterion, so the WCAG 2.0 pack applies here through its also_required_via extension. State, local, tribal, territorial, and District of Columbia privacy, language, records, and security overlays require a jurisdiction specialist before any whole-profile claim.
